description: This Java source file defines the ExternalBlockHandler class, which handles RPC requests for serving shuffle and RDD blocks in Apache Spark. It manages registering executors, opening shuffle or disk blocks, handling shuffle merge operations, and collecting related metrics.

classes.name: ExternalBlockHandler
classes.description: Main class handling RPC requests for shuffle and RDD blocks, managing executor registration, block serving, shuffle merge operations, and metrics collection.

classes.name: ShuffleMetrics
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating metrics related to shuffle operations such as latency, transfer rates, and connection counts.

classes.name: ManagedBufferIterator
classes.description: Iterator for managing buffers based on OpenBlocks or shuffle chunk IDs, parsing block IDs and fetching data accordingly.

classes.name: ShuffleManagedBufferIterator
classes.description: Iterator for shuffle blocks, supporting batch and non-batch fetch modes.

classes.name: ShuffleChunkManagedBufferIterator
classes.description: Iterator for shuffle chunk blocks, parsing chunk IDs and fetching merged block data.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, decodes them, and delegates to handleMessage.

methods.name: receiveStream
methods.description: Handles stream requests for block data, supporting push block streams.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes different types of BlockTransferMessage requests such as fetch, register, remove, and shuffle merge operations.

methods.name: receiveMergeBlockMetaReq
methods.description: Handles requests for merged block metadata.

methods.name: getMergedBlockMetaReqHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler for merged block meta requests.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Returns the metrics set for monitoring.

methods.name: applicationRemoved
methods.description: Removes application data and optionally cleans local directories.

methods.name: executorRemoved
methods.description: Cleans up data related to a finished executor.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes resources related to block and shuffle managers.

methods.name: checkAuth
methods.description: Checks client authorization based on application ID.
